images.caption: Figure 1:LMBuild Framework(Using real example produced by GPT-6 Astra). Given a text prompt and conditional image, the builder LLM agent uses tools to inspect and select existing parts, create new parts, and place and adjust components to construct the wheelchair. It then specifies joints, materials, and an assembly sequence to support kinematics and physical-world realization.

Figure 2:Left:Generation examples produced by the LMBuild framework. Colors are used only to visually distinguish decomposed components.Right:The generated structures are evaluated using our comprehensive set of evaluation metrics. We briefly illustrate the reference source and general evaluation procedure for each metric; full evaluation details are provided in AppendixA.4.
